method: cross-correlation of joint activity (log1p of max joint speed) with motion energy from out/motion_<cam>.npz; lags -0.5..+0.5 s; offset = video - joint (video_time = joint_time + offset). NOT the onset method in the spec: deviation.

close.note: episode lags 0 to 12 frames; low confidence

quantisation: one frame at 30 fps (33 ms); spreads below this are not resolved
stage1_note: out/clock_offsets_stage1.json has the sign inverted relative to the stated convention and is not used
